title: CrewAI autolog credential key filter: _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN drops api_key, secret, password, Authorization and *Token keys but keeps max_tokens and tokenizer
answers: Does mlflow CrewAI tracing hide Authorization headers or auth_token fields?
Why are max_tokens or tokenizer missing / present in CrewAI LLM span attributes?
How do I make a new CrewAI provider credential field get redacted from traces?
Which CrewAI field names are treated as secrets when tracing?
body:
Path: mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN is the single key-name filter. It is checked in _set_sanitized_attribute, in the attribute builders _get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes and _get_llm_attributes, and in the dict walk of _sanitize_value. Any CrewAI LLM, Agent, Task or Crew field name passes through it.
Rule: The pattern matches api_key / api-key / secret / password / authorization / credential anywhere in the key, so Authorization and openai_api_key are dropped. It matches token only as a standalone word, a snake_case suffix (_token), or a camelCase suffix (accessToken, BearerToken), so max_tokens, tokenizer and token_usage are kept. Key-name checks run before the value is read.
Symptom: Fields such as auth_token or client_secret on a provider config were written to spans as plain strings, because the value-level sanitizer only recognizes model objects and api_key-like dict keys.
Constraints: The pattern is name-based, so a credential field with a name it does not match (e.g. a bare "key" or "pwd") will still be written. When adding a provider field that holds a secret, extend the pattern and add the name to test_set_sanitized_attribute_skips_credential_keys in tests/crewai/test_crewai_autolog.py. Callbacks are skipped separately in _get_llm_attributes.
applies: Any new CrewAI field, provider config option or key name that might carry a credential before it reaches a span.
says: Authorization headers or auth tokens show up in MLflow CrewAI traces
CrewAI span attributes show api_key or client secret values in plain text
Max tokens or tokenizer fields are missing from CrewAI LLM trace attributes
How do I stop a new CrewAI provider credential field from appearing in traces?
search: CrewAI autolog credential key-name filter: the sensitive-key pattern drops api_key, secret, password, authorization and credential names plus token as a standalone word, snake suffix or camel suffix, while keeping max_tokens, tokenizer and token_usage. Name-based only, so unmatched names like bare key or pwd still pass. New secret provider fields need the pattern extended and a test added.
